leadText:
The Valley of Steel (Japanese: ハガネの Valley of Steel) is an -exclusive location in the Hoenn region that appeared in All Torkoal, No Play. It is located between Lavaridge Town and Mauville City.

 inhabit the valley, including its skies, and violently protect it from any intruders, including , who accidentally stumbled into the area. A road cutting across the Valley of Steel is considered a shortcut. There is a river close to Mauville City at the valley's edge.

 and were traveling through the Valley of Steel when they saw Torkoal being attacked by a Skarmory and . After several skirmishes, Ash helped Torkoal defeat its rival, a who ruled over the valley. Afterwards, Torkoal decided to join his team.
